description: PHP flat-file CMS with JSON-backed content, administrative editing, HTTP content API, independently installable publishing plugins and three website themes.
coverage_note: Full pinned tree and 680 text-file extraction reconciled. Reviewed the CMS entry/boot architecture, core JSON store and authentication/security surfaces; plugin manifests, English feature descriptions and PHP hook declarations identify all 26 bundled plugins, including the HTTP API boundary; three theme entry points identify independent theme templates. Localized text, vendored editor internals, admin CRUD screens, helpers, assets and issue housekeeping are not independent assets. The API is represented once as API rather than duplicated as a generic plugin. Core security/storage subsystems are retained as extraction references because their contracts can be compared independently.

dependencies: Bludit JSON stores and global runtime objects
entity_defaults.overlap: Independent Bludit extension or subsystem; compose with the CMS host rather than treating internal lifecycle methods as separate assets.

entities.name: Bludit flat-file publishing CMS
entities.description: Self-hosted PHP website and blog publishing application with JSON-backed content, Markdown/HTML pages, an admin area and a plugin/theme lifecycle; no external database server is required.
dependencies: mbstring, gd, dom and json PHP modules

entities.name: Bludit dbJSON store
entities.description: Small PHP JSON file store supporting in-memory records, snapshots/restoration, field access, persistence with an exclusive write lock and an optional PHP guard line for web-hosted data files.

entities.name: Bludit session authentication
entities.description: CMS login subsystem coordinating user/password checks, regenerated PHP sessions, user-agent fingerprints and remembered-login tokens with the Bludit user store.

metadata.deployment_warning: User store hashes passwords with salted SHA-1; replace with a password-specific adaptive hash before treating this as a modern authentication foundation.

entities.name: Bludit request security controls
entities.description: CMS request-security subsystem generating and checking session CSRF tokens and tracking per-IP failed-login blocking with a configured duration and threshold.

entities.name: Bludit About sidebar
entities.description: Configurable sidebar block presenting a short site or author introduction.

entities.name: Bludit Alternative theme settings
entities.description: Theme companion exposing Alternative-theme settings for post information, Google Fonts, dates and related presentation choices.

entities.name: Bludit content HTTP API
entities.description: Token-gated HTTP interface for reading pages, tags and categories and for administrator-authorized page, category, user, settings, image and file operations.

metadata.deployment_warning: API token grants read access; write access additionally requires an enabled administrator authentication token. Configure allowed origins and protect both credentials.

entities.name: Bludit Canonical URLs
entities.description: Publishes canonical URL metadata in the page head to identify preferred versions of duplicate website URLs.

entities.name: Bludit Category sidebar
entities.description: Renders the site category list in the sidebar, with a setting to hide categories that have no content.

entities.name: Bludit Custom fields parser
entities.description: Replaces page custom-field placeholders with administrator-configured markup and field values before Markdown rendering and relative-image URL rewriting.

entities.name: Bludit Disqus comments
entities.description: Embeds the hosted Disqus comment interface on selected page types using a configured Disqus site shortname.
dependencies: Browser access to external Disqus scripts

entities.name: Bludit Hit Counter
entities.description: Displays total visits or unique-visitor counts in a site sidebar using the host's visit statistics.

entities.name: Bludit HTML injection hooks
entities.description: Adds administrator-configured HTML, CSS or JavaScript to site and admin head/body insertion hooks.

metadata.deployment_warning: Configured code executes in visitor or administrator browsers; restrict configuration to trusted administrators.

entities.name: Bludit Link sidebar
entities.description: Maintains and displays an administrator-configurable sidebar list of external or internal links.

entities.name: Bludit Maintenance mode
entities.description: Intercepts public site requests with a configurable maintenance message while retaining access to the administration area.

entities.name: Bludit Page navigation
entities.description: Builds sidebar navigation from parent and child pages with configurable home-link and item-count options.

entities.name: Bludit Open Graph metadata
entities.description: Generates Open Graph page metadata and image fallbacks for social sharing previews.

entities.name: Bludit Remote Content synchronization
entities.description: Webhook-triggered replacement of site content from a configured remote ZIP archive, parsing imported Markdown pages into the CMS. The process deletes existing pages and uploads before regenerating content.

metadata.deployment_warning: Destructive replacement and direct ZIP extraction: use only with trusted archives, backups and an isolated deployment after adding archive/path validation and recovery handling.

entities.name: Bludit Robots directives
entities.description: Provides robots metadata and request hooks for controlling search-engine indexing and link following.

entities.name: Bludit RSS publishing
entities.description: Generates and serves a configurable RSS XML feed and refreshes it after content creation, modification or deletion.

entities.name: Bludit Content Search
entities.description: Adds a site-content search box and cached search results with result counts, pagination, excerpts and optional search-term highlighting.

entities.name: Bludit XML sitemap
entities.description: Generates a sitemap XML page list and updates it through CMS page lifecycle hooks.

entities.name: Bludit Static-page navigation
entities.description: Builds a sidebar navigation menu from static CMS pages with optional home navigation.

entities.name: Bludit SunEditor integration
entities.description: Integrates SunEditor into CMS content editing, including configurable toolbar groups and media insertion hooks for HTML authoring.

entities.name: Bludit Tag sidebar
entities.description: Displays a sidebar list of site tags for content discovery.

entities.name: Bludit TinyMCE integration
entities.description: Integrates the bundled TinyMCE HTML editor with CMS toolbars, context menus, code-sample language choices and media insertion hooks.

metadata.license: Bundled TinyMCE: GPL-2.0-or-later per its pinned license.md; bundled DOMPurify retains Apache-2.0/MPL-2.0 notices
metadata.deployment_warning: Root CMS MIT metadata does not replace the bundled editor's license obligations.

entities.name: Bludit TOAST UI Markdown editor
entities.description: Integrates TOAST UI Editor with live WYSIWYG preview and CMS media hooks while saving Markdown content; the bundled integration intentionally targets editor version 2.5.4.
dependencies: Bundled TOAST UI Editor 2.5.4 and CodeMirror

entities.name: Bludit Twitter Card metadata
entities.description: Generates Twitter/X Card page metadata with a configurable default image for shared links.

entities.name: Bludit Version notifications
entities.description: Shows the installed CMS version in the administration sidebar and checks for newer Bludit releases.

entities.name: Bludit Visit statistics
entities.description: Collects daily visits and hashed-IP unique visitors into local logs, retains seven daily logs and exposes dashboard chart data and counts.

metadata.deployment_warning: Unsalted MD5 IP hashes remain linkable visitor data; restrict log access and assess privacy/consent requirements before collection.

entities.name: Bludit Alternative website theme
entities.description: Responsive website/blog theme using Bootstrap with social/static-page navigation, accessibility skip navigation and a companion settings plugin.

entities.name: Bludit Blog X theme
entities.description: Bootstrap blog theme composing post/page views with a right sidebar, footer and social/static-page navigation.

entities.name: Bludit Flavor blog theme
entities.description: Minimal Tailwind-styled blog theme with a centered article column, dark-mode classes and dedicated home, page and not-found views.

exclude.reason: Generic stale-issue housekeeping is repository maintenance noise, not a reusable publishing capability.

scoped_review.conclusion: Catalog review resolves the sensitive surfaces without claiming production safety. Login regenerates sessions but the user store uses salted SHA-1; retain authentication as a reference and require adaptive password hashing for reuse. API reads require the plugin token and writes require an enabled administrator token; configure CORS and protect credentials. Remote Content directly extracts an archive then deletes page/upload directories: retained with AVOID FOR PRODUCTION and a backup/trusted-archive warning. Visit analytics stores unsalted hashed IPs, requiring privacy controls. Administrator HTML injection executes browser code by design. Bundled TinyMCE explicitly declares GPL-2.0-or-later, distinct from the MIT CMS, with DOMPurify notices retained. Runtime behavior was not tested.

implementation_details: Localized plugin/theme strings and README translations
Individual admin controllers/views and ordinary helpers
Bundled editor implementation internals represented as dependencies of their integration plugins
